name: Streak-capped Spinetail
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Mostly brown arboreal spinetail with a black-streaked rufous crown and rufous wings and tail. Has a narrow white eyebrow, diffuse pale streaks on face, and slightly downcurved bill.

name: Talaud Bush-hen
rangeDescription: Talaud islands (northern moluccas)
description: A large, entirely dark, pale-billed rail confined to the Talaud Archipelago. Upperparts and head dark brown, underparts completely slate-colored.

name: Zigzag Heron
rangeDescription: Locally in ponds and streams of the amazon basin
description: Small, dark, rarely seen heron of forest. Plumage is entirely gray-brown with fine black vermiculations; young birds sport warmer tones.

name: Beautiful Sunbird
rangeDescription: Mauritania, senegal, and guinea-bissau eastward to sudan, eritrea, and ethiopia, southward to sierra leone, central nigeria, northern cameroon, central african republic, south sudan, extreme northeastern democratic republic of the congo, uganda, and northwestern kenya
description: A slim, long-billed sunbird in which breeding males and females are very different. Breeding males are mostly dark green with a red-and-yellow band across the underparts.

name: Bamboo Antshrike
rangeDescription: Local from southeastern peru to northwestern bolivia and southwestern amazonian brazil
description: Small antshrike of bamboo thickets in lowland rainforest. Found primarily in bamboo forests, but occasionally also in other densely vegetated thickets such as vine tangles and cane stands.

name: Chestnut-capped Foliage-gleaner
rangeDescription: Campos of interior eastern and south-central brazil to northeastern paraguay
description: Large foliage-gleaner with startling yellow eyes and a long bill and tail. Rather uniform rufous above and paler below.

name: Waigeo Brushturkey
rangeDescription: Waigeo (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A very little-known, large, black ground bird endemic to the upland forests on Waigeo Island. Black above with some chestnut in the breast and a bare pink head and throat.

name: Mexican Sheartail
rangeDescription: Hills of barranca de naolinco, central veracruz (east-central mexico), and disjunctly in coastal thornscrub and gardens of northwestern to north-central yucatán peninsula (southeastern mexico)
description: Only in Mexico. Fairly common small hummingbird of dry coastal scrub in northern Yucatan Peninsula; also very local in dry scrub of central Veracruz.

name: Yellow-crowned Euphonia
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern nicaragua to costa rica and panama
description: Small finchlike bird, compact and short tailed. Generally yellow below and dark blue-black above with stout, short bill.

name: Grande Comore Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Grand comoro island (mount karthala)
description: A distinctive and attractive flycatcher that is endemic to Grand Comoro. Dark brown on the upperparts and heavily streaked below, with a yellow bill and feet and white wingbars.

name: Nilgiri Sholakili
rangeDescription: Peninsular india (nilgiri hills of mysore and western madras)
description: Dumpy little bird, slaty-blue with a tan belly. Highly restricted and scattered range in the Nilgiri Hills, where it is found at 900-2100 meters of elevation in sholas (patches of stunted montane forest separated by open grassy areas).

name: Indian Peafowl
rangeDescription: Forest and scrub of eastern pakistan, india, and sri lanka
description: An unmistakable, large ground bird. The unmistakable iridescent blue male spreads out its ornamental upper tail feathers when courting females.

name: Tibetan Bunting
rangeDescription: Western china (borders of arid tibet, southwestern qinghai, and sichuan)
description: Handsome thickset bunting restricted to a small part of the eastern Qinghai-Tibetan plateau where it inhabits scrubby slopes above the timberline. Unmistakable in its range; no other bunting in the area combines its size, brick-orange back, and gray belly.

name: Makatea Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Makatea island (western tuamotu archipelago)
description: A relatively slender fruit-dove that appears mostly green with a greenish belly, a silver chest and head, a magenta forehead, and an orange bill. Similar to Atoll Fruit-Dove, but much more boldly colored, with dark instead of pink legs.

name: White-browed Woodswallow
rangeDescription: Inland eastern and south-central australia; winters to north
description: Chunky bird with broad, triangular wings and short, decurved bill. Male dark gray above, dark orange-brown below, with dark gray face and throat and white eyebrow.

name: Pohnpei Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Pohnpei (eastern caroline islands)
description: The only kingfisher on Pohnpei. Dashing, with a dark greenish-blue back, snow-white underparts and collar, and orange crown.

name: Okinawa Robin
rangeDescription: Okinawa (central ryukyu islands, southern japan)
description: Endemic resident of shady subtropical broadleaf forest understorey on the main island of Okinawa. Forages on the ground and often seen at the forest edge.

name: Javan Robin
rangeDescription: Mountains of java
description: Medium-sized robin of Java’s montane and foothill forests. Male is dark blue, with a bright white spot on the forehead.

name: Wetar Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (timor and wetar)
description: A fairly large ground-dwelling forest dove. Male is mostly dark with a diagnostic pale head and breast.

name: Black-faced Monarch
rangeDescription: Eastern australia (cooktown to northeastern victoria); winters to new guinea
description: A slim songbird with rather long tail and substantial bill. Gray above, rufous below, with gray head, black forehead and throat.
